drivingQuestion: Does a buyer who paid part acquire only if the balance is written as a loan?
outcomeNote: the question is taken up in the next unit

segments.he: רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל אוֹמֵר: מְלַמְּדִין אוֹתָן שֶׁלֹּא יַחְזְרוּ. כֵּיצַד? כּוֹתֵב לוֹ: ״אֲנִי פְּלוֹנִי בֶּן פְּלוֹנִי כּוּ׳״. טַעְמָא דִּכְתַב לֵיהּ הָכִי, הָא לָא כְּתַב הָכִי – לָא קָנֵי?
segments.en: § It is further stated in the baraita that «Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says: We teach them not to renege. How so? He writes for him: I, so-and-so, son of so-and-so,» sold such and such a field to so-and-so for one thousand dinars, and of them he gave me two hundred dinars. And therefore, now he owes me eight hundred dinars. This effects acquisition of the field for the buyer immediately. The Gemara asks: «The reason» they cannot renege «is that» the seller «wrote this for» the buyer in the contract. Evidently, «if not for this» being specified in a document the buyer «does not acquire» the field immediately.

moves.summary: so without this writing he would not acquire?
moves.about: without such a document the buyer does not acquire
